title: fleet_burn._write_baseline: uncaught OSError when STATE dir missing
description: 3x codereview of lh2z fix (edge finding 1): scripts/fleet_burn.py:37-39 _write_baseline catches nothing; if /tmp/fleet-driver-state is deleted mid-run (tmp cleaner, manual cleanup), FileNotFoundError kills the helper each cycle. fleet-guards.sh mkdir -p runs once at startup so it never recovers until restart; baseline now written once per 24h so mtimes age a full day, raising tmp-cleaner relevance. Fix: os.makedirs(dirname, exist_ok=True) before the tmp write, or catch OSError and return a distinguishable reason dict.
